---
title: "PageHeader"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
source(file.path("..", "..", "shots.R"))
```

If the path of the page is simple, a page header instead of a breadcrumb.
`input$<id>_back` fires when the back arrow is clicked.

## Basic

```{r basic, eval = FALSE, shot = TRUE}
el_page_header("head", content = "detail")
```

## API

```{r api, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
api_tables("page-header")
```
